Shapes | Fullstack Engineer (AI Product) | ONSITE | San Francisco | Full-time

We’re building an AI chat platform where humans and AI interact in group chats, voice, and video.

Small team, high ownership, ship fast. We talk to users and build things we actually use.

We’re looking for a fullstack engineer to build product features end-to-end.

What you’ll do: - Build and ship features across frontend and backend - Work on real-time chat, onboarding flows, and AI interactions - Own features from idea → production - Collaborate closely with design and iterate quickly

Tech stack: React / Next.js, Python, real-time systems

Looking for: - Strong fullstack experience - Product mindset (you care about UX, not just code) - High agency - you move fast and take ownership

Apply: https://shapes.inc/jobs Checkout what we are building on https://talk.shapes.inc/
